newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to be pulled down towards 4,560.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to be pulled down towards 4,560.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will be pulled down towards 4,560 on Monday, technical analysts said.

The market showed its downward tendencies on Friday when it tumbled almost 60 points, dropping below 4,600. This has also dented short-term momentum readings for the FTSE which indicate weak trading conditions, they said.
The FTSE's 10-day momentum is now minus 51, indicating a deteriorating market and analysts expect this indicator to go deeper into negative territory.
The FTSE 100 was up 3.1 to 4,597.0 by 0730 GMT.
"Attempts to resist further falls will be small," one analyst said.
"Such resistance will be overcome due to the overwhelming declining trend of the past week(when FTSE fell 189 points)."
"So long as it(the FTSE)remains below its 10-day moving average, the market has little chance to swing back up," he added.
The FTSE's 10-day moving average is currently reading 4,693 and has begun to slope down following the index lower.
